I went through it — pasted a link, tweaked the title, hit **Save bookmark** — and it dropped me into "Your bookmarks" with what I'd just saved sitting there as a card: the picture, the site's little icon and name, the title, and the description all on it. That's exactly what I was hoping for. Seeing the thing I just kept show up right away, laid out so I can recognize it at a glance, is the whole point for me.

(Just so you know, the still screenshots you attached this round all show the empty start screen, not the collection — but the app itself does land on the card view when I actually save, so no worry there.)

This feels right. Down the line I'll care about how the list works once there are lots of these — finding and organizing them — but for what you asked, landing in the collection with the saved card looks good.
